title: Will you ever forget his goggle eye?
html_source: Referring to how he ogled at her.

anchor.text: Will you ever forget his goggle eye?
anchor.prefix:
laughter sprang from Miss Kennedy's throat. Miss Douce huffed and snorted down her nostrils that quivered imperthnthn like a snout in quest. 

 — O! shrieking, Miss Kennedy cried.
anchor.suffix:
Miss Douce chimed in in deep bronze laughter, shouting: 

 — And your other eye! 

 Bloowhose dark eye read Aaron Figatner's name. Why do I always think Figather? Gathering fig
